verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents self-hosting as giving 'Full control over data location' and can run anywhere Docker runs, letting users choose their own region/residency by hosting infrastructure themselves. However, there is no evidence of an explicit region-selection feature for Appwrite Cloud (e.g., a dropdown to pick a data-center region), so residency is only achievable via self-managed deployment rather than a first-class product control. Missing for 10: documented multi-region Cloud offering, explicit UI/API for choosing data region, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
